Approved evidence

SWAA task collection

benchmark.metr-swaa

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The primary Time Horizon paper explicitly constructs a named 66-task SWAA collection with its own development, filtering and human reference procedures. Independent identity review supports a named task-collection boundary while withholding stronger standalone benchmark typing. The retained inventory identifier keeps its historical benchmark prefix; the semantic entity kind is dataset_family. SWAA is an input component of the composite Time Horizon protocol, not an independently operated benchmark established here. Preliminary tasks, five internal groups and prompt-development tasks are not separate families. No inspected full payload or release-rights clearance is asserted. Actual author, separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content review records bind every approved claim at its exact scientific digest. This metadata classification does not freeze core eligibility.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SWAA task collection · benchmark task: Software Atomic Actions (SWAA) consists of 66 short tasks representing software-engineering actions under one minute, using multiple-choice decisions and fill-in-the-blank completion questions.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next8.metr.swaa.atomic-task-content.v1

  • Its five internal groups cover file selection, alert triage, request routing, code completion and simple arithmetic; these groups are components of SWAA.
  • The benchmark is intended to extend measurement below the roughly one-minute lower end of HCAST tasks.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SWAA task collection · filtered: SWAA’s authors wrote an initial 71 tasks without seeing AI attempts or running models on the developing tasks, then retained 66 after excluding tasks that more than one human baseliner failed.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next8.metr.swaa.blind-task-development-and-filter.v1

  • Development of the few-shot evaluation prompt used a separate development task suite.
  • The stated blinding concerns task development relative to model performance; human baseline failures still affected final task selection.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

SWAA task collection · human annotation: SWAA human baselines were collected from internal employees with relevant expertise using a custom web application, with four baselines per decision task and three per fill-in-the-blank task.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next8.metr.swaa.internal-human-reference-protocol.v1

  • Timing begins after general instructions and ends when a response is chosen, including reading the question and choosing an answer while excluding context acquisition.
  • Decision tasks permit one selection; fill-in-the-blank tasks permit repeated attempts until correct or skipped.

SWAA task collection · documents: The time-horizon paper credits Thomas Kwa with leading SWAA task development and Amy Deng with creating most SWAA tasks and collecting their human baselines and AI agent results.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next8.metr.swaa.named-data-production-roles.v1
